description: Basically, Späti crawl stands for a night of exploring the Fabulous streets of Berlin always in different Districts of the City, meaning you not following the same trail as any other Traditional Bar Crawl in Berlin. But what I will get from this?... well There is a lot, 1.-A walking drinking Experience without the expensive prices of regular Pub / Bars (even if you don't drink Alcohol) 3.-As self-service, you expend what you want to drink and as much you want from .80€ cent to 1.80€ premium and Craft Beers, also, if you are not a beer drinker you can find any other kinds of drinks like Ciders, Wine or cocktails drinks with, where you can find at any Späti Kiosk. What is a Späti: Basically, a Späti, it’s a convenience store. or Liquor Store sort. They’re not specific to Berlin, but in Berlin, there’s at least a Späti on every street. where you pay as little as .80 euro cents for a beer. People (tourists and locals alike) typically stop in a Späti on their way out, on their way home, or on their way anywhere. In a city where public drinking is tolerated.
hostdescription:
My Name is Pablo ''Aka'' Charlie.

a now Adopted Berliner, and urban Explorer... I started this tradition as a social event every weekend with some Seasonal Travelers and Backpackers...
for more the 5 years and every single Weekend since then, we hold a unique experience to explore and feel The unique of walking around the streets of Berlin, in a way to meet, have a drink and mingle with new People from all walk of life and many countries
as Budget Bender, this for everyone who wants to experience Berlin in a different way.

This was essentially an experience where you walk around with Pablo (and the other people who signed up for the experience obviously) to his favorite watering holes.

To be clear, these are not bars. They’re basically like bodegas that sell alcohol on the cheap with picnic tables outside of them. The people who frequent these bodega things are all locals. Definitely not places that are on any tourist guide of “places to check out”. These places are not special in any kind of way other than being just a local spot. It sounds kind of weird, but it’s actually great. You go to like 5-6 of them, walking to each one.

As with most Airbnb experiences (at least for me) it is the people I meet that make them so fun. My group was awesome. Two Bavarians, two Hollanders, two Canadians, and another American. All were fun and interesting and friendly. After the experience we all went to a karaoke bar (we did that on our own, Pablo had to dip!)

Pablo did a good job getting people to vibe, and keeping the energy right.

Pablo is clearly a regular at all the places he brings you, and everyone knows him. We met up with a few of his friends as well. He brings speakers and plays great music as you wander from place to place. A lot of 90’s hip hop.

Anyway, I had a fantastic time, and would definitely do it again.

Super unique. Great fun!

After the tour Pablo walked us right to the train station and saw that we got on the right train to get back to our hotel. I must admit I was a bit skeptical when I first saw the ad for this. (My wife and I can be a bit conservative), but we loved it! I'd highly recommend Pablo and the Spati Crawl to tourists of all ages (well, above the drinking age of course!)

The host did not give any context on why spati's are important to the local culture, how they came up, why they are owned by not Germans but people from other ethnicities. We stayed for a full 4 hours and regret that we did. Neither the neighborhood we visited nor the commentary were engaging. This tour is for those who have time to kill and not much else to do. I would not recommend this if you have limited time in Berlin.

I'm fairly social and after 10 minutes I'd descovered there was an excellent eclectic mix of locals, expats and travellers who I'd never have met otherwise. Also, I'd never have experienced such a tour which was excellent. Its pretty relaxed and perfect for a street drinking tour. We all hit a club later on. Pablo is great! :)

In sum: the experience was nice and I recommend it!

I gave the experience 4 out 5 stars not because there was something missing or could’ve been different but because a 5-star experience is rare. It depends on so many circumstances beyond a host’s control (one’s mood, people joining the experience, people at the place at a particular moment) that hard to always get to 5 stars. So Pablo is an attentive guide and I had a quite relaxing and pleasant evening and the fellow participants were also nice. Everything went well.
It was an amazing and unique experience. Pablo was the perfect guide, gave great recommendations and made sure that everyone was having a good time. I would join the Späti Crawl again any time!

Wanna drinking some great beers and have a chat with lots of people? Then this is the experience to go. You will get to tour some random parts of Berlin that you normally won't venture into and chat with people from various parts of the world.

The best part of my journey in Berlin! It was more than amazing to make new friends over beers, especially when you get the chance to try some new beer. I would definitely do this again when I come to Berlin once again!

I had such a great time I can't even remember what happened! As a person who is not very social I thought this was going to be an awkward time. It actually was the most fun I have had in a long time! I got to meet people from all around the world and understand why Berlin is truly an amazing city.

Pablo was laid back and quick on his feet. We had a very rainy night and his direction adjusted quickly and led to a very fun evening. Will never forget.

I really do recommend this tour!
A nice way of having a really good time with a lot of different people, we've spent a really nice couple of hours. Plus Pablo is really nice and he looked after everyone and everything going well.

If you want a laugh and to make friends with people from all over the world, sign up for this event! We had a great time!
